description: This Java class defines configuration properties for a Prometheus-based resource limit checking component within the Eclipse Hono project. It includes fields for host, port, cache sizes, and cache timeout, along with their getters and setters, and defaults.

classes.name: PrometheusBasedResourceLimitChecksConfig
classes.description: Final class that holds configuration properties for Prometheus resource limit checks, including host, port, cache sizes, and cache timeout, with validation logic in setters.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the hostname or IP address of the Prometheus server.

methods.name: setHost
methods.description: Sets the hostname or IP address of the Prometheus server, requiring a non-null value.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number used to connect to the Prometheus server.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets the port number for the Prometheus server, validating the port range via PortConfigurationHelper.

methods.name: getCacheMinSize
methods.description: Returns the minimum size of the cache.

methods.name: setCacheMinSize
methods.description: Sets the minimum cache size, ensuring it is non-negative.

methods.name: getCacheMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of the cache.

methods.name: setCacheMaxSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum cache size, ensuring it is non-negative.

methods.name: getCacheTimeout
methods.description: Returns the cache timeout in seconds.

methods.name: setCacheTimeout
methods.description: Sets the cache timeout, validating it is greater than zero.
